authority: Static House Tang administrative program rules. This file registers lawful program templates and treasury-safety policy; it does not prove that any campaign program has been accepted or opened.

treasury_safety.rule: A new discretionary House program may receive at most the registered fraction of cash remaining after the protected stable-expense reserve. Opening a program reserves no money and spends nothing by itself.

field_preparation.rule: An explicitly requested House Tang campaign-preparation stage may load at most seven days of departure food and fodder from exact House stores. It may form already-conserved Tang Wei personal-force manpower and issue only exact registered stock. Missing equipment remains a persisted shortfall rather than being manufactured by narration.

great_bow_guard.standards_rule: Selection standards are never lowered merely to fill the establishment.

candidate_training.rule: After registered regional and residential screening, retained candidates receive at most 56 deliberate training hours per seven-day review. Four completed review blocks are the minimum candidate-training phase before acceptance into Tang Wei's conserved personal force. House Tang remains sponsor and supplier. Acceptance does not create their field formation or equipment issue. The campaign preserves 15 recruitment/provenance cohorts at 200 fighters each; those cohorts also provide the conserved internal command-candidate body. The single 3,000-man formation has one commander and one deputy unless it is lawfully split into separate formations.

great_bow_guard.opening_rule: Opening applicant intake creates no fighter headcount, formation, equipment issue, spending, or completed recruitment. Candidate screening, acceptance, training, equipment, officer appointment and formation creation remain separate conserved consequences.

sword_manor_initiates.intake_rule: House-requested intake may fill only an exact existing trainee vacancy and must consume conserved Qin population. It never grants training time. Existing trainees continue only through the normal Sword Manor training cycle.

sword_manor_officer_cadre.rule: Sword Manor officers are conserved military personnel, not decorative rank counts. They are not the default source of Great Bow Guard internal commanders. A Sword Manor officer may be seconded only through an explicit lawful transfer for staff, instruction, replacement or a specific appointment. New officers still require promotion gates and vacancies; authorization never creates bodies.
